title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
abstract: arXiv:2611.31233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. Retrieval fails when wrong matches, or hard negatives, outrank the correct one, and the gap is the usual suspect. Yet removing it post hoc degrades retrieval on every CLIP checkpoint we test. We introduce a paired statistic that identifies directions where the two towers agree more on hard negatives than on matched pairs. Mildly attenuating these directions improves retrieval while largely preserving the gap. We arrive at this correction through weight-space programming: guided by the statistic, an LLM agent inspects both towers and writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation. Free to edit any component, the agent improves COCO test retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints and edits an output projection in 12 of the 13. We distill and refine its rec

translated_title: TowerBridge：通过权重空间编程弥合双编码器模态鸿沟
translated_abstract: CLIP风格的双编码器通过两个独立的塔将图像和文本映射到一个共享嵌入空间，其中两种模态占据被模态鸿沟分隔开的不同区域。当错误匹配或困难负样本的得分超过正确匹配时，检索就会失败，而模态鸿沟通常被认为是罪魁祸首。然而，事后直接消除这一鸿沟在我们测试的每一个CLIP检查点上都会降低检索性能。我们引入了一种配对统计量，用于识别两个塔在困难负样本上比在正确匹配对上更加一致的方向。轻微衰减这些方向可以在基本保留模态鸿沟的同时改进检索性能。我们通过权重空间编程得到这一修正：在该统计量的引导下，一个LLM智能体检查双塔的结构，并在无需反向传播的情况下写出闭式（解析形式的）权重编辑。由于可以自由编辑任意组件，该智能体在全部13个CLIP检查点上都改进了COCO测试集的检索性能，并且在其中12个检查点上编辑了输出投影。我们对其编辑方案进行蒸馏与精炼……
tldr: 提出TowerBridge方法，借助配对统计量识别并轻微衰减导致困难负样本混淆的方向，同时通过权重空间编程让LLM智能体无需反向传播即可写出闭式权重编辑，在保留模态鸿沟的前提下改进了全部13个CLIP检查点在COCO上的检索性能。
en_tdlr: TowerBridge uses a paired statistic to identify and mildly attenuate directions where the two towers confuse hard negatives, and via weight-space programming an LLM agent writes closed-form weight edits without backpropagation, improving COCO retrieval on all 13 CLIP checkpoints while largely preserving the modality gap.
